description: A man in a feathered headdress with a jade bead necklace, ear spools and a round carved shield stands in the foreground holding a staff. Behind him, several figures carry baskets along a forest path. The setting is a tropical river valley with thatched huts and a stepped stone pyramid at right. Clothing and architecture look Maya or Mesoamerican, with no visible letters, numbers or frame. The painting runs edge to edge.
